title: The Day of the Dead
text:
In Mexico, many people celebrate the Day of the Dead in November. Families make colorful food and sweet bread. They put flowers and candles on their tables.

The day is not sad. People remember their family and friends who died. They sing, tell stories, and eat together. Children often wear face paint.

questions.text: Why do families put food and flowers on their tables?
options: To honor family members who died
To sell them at the market
To give them to the police
